description: Tool to retrieve summaries of all Google Analytics accounts accessible by the caller. Use when you need a high-level overview of accounts and their properties without fetching full account details.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing Account Summaries.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of account summaries to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. Maximum value is 200; higher values will be coerced to the maximum.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Page token received from a previous ListAccountSummaries call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to ListAccountSummaries must match the call that provided the page token.
pageToken.title: Page Token

inputSchema.title: ListAccountSummariesRequest

name: list_account_summaries

AccountSummary.description: Summary of a Google Analytics account with its properties.

account.description: Resource name of the account. Format: accounts/{account_id}.
account.title: Account

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the account.
displayName.title: Display Name

name.description: Resource name of this account summary. Format: accountSummaries/{account_id}.
name.title: Name

propertySummaries.description: List of summaries for child properties under this account.
propertySummaries.title: Property Summaries

AccountSummary.title: AccountSummary

ListAccountSummariesResponse.description: Response model for listing Account Summaries.

accountSummaries.description: Account summaries of all accounts the caller has access to.
accountSummaries.title: Account Summaries

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

ListAccountSummariesResponse.title: ListAccountSummariesResponse

PropertySummary.description: Summary of a Google Analytics property.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the property.
displayName.title: Display Name

parent.description: Resource name of the property's parent account or property.
parent.title: Parent

property.description: Resource name of the property. Format: properties/{property_id}.
property.title: Property

PropertySummary.title: PropertySummary
